provenance.asset_description: Vira Dorven, artist Ernst Eskelsen: A corpsefolk wearing the uniform of an officer in the Corpse Fleet casts a spell, sending a disk of condensed gravity flying through the air. She wears her stringy hair up in a tight bun and keeps her uniform pristine. Some of her teeth and a piece of her mandible are visible through the gaps in her rotting cheek.
